query: Please implement a cloud database management platform to unify database interface management and provide peripheral capabilities. The platform should have functionalities such as interface management, SDK generation, online debugging, and forwarding support. Users should be able to log in to the platform, manage database interfaces, generate SDKs, perform online debugging, and configure forwarding support. The platform should also provide peripheral capabilities, such as unified login, host management, database performance monitoring, auditing, and log management. Choose desert sand for global background and sienna for all components.
